rule: One single-colour, vertically symmetric, right-opening bracket sits on a black background. Erase the strokes. Fill every bbox cell to the right of each row's rightmost stroke cell, up to the bbox right column x1. Mirror each filled cell to 2*x1+1-x. The result is a left/right symmetric blob in the bracket colour.
scope: Erase a vertically symmetric right-opening bracket, fill the cells to the right of each row stroke within its bounding box, and reflect that fill across the right bounding-box edge.

authored_scope: Supported: square brackets with caps, diagonal chevrons, and stepped or irregular chevrons with monotone offsets. Height ranges over 3..29 (odd) or 4..30 (even), and x1 = offsets[-1]+cap over 1..14. Grid width, height, placement and colour are sampled. Random shapes scale with the available canvas: up to 15 half-rows and x1 up to 14 on 30x30, with regular or random-composition step profiles, varying caps and both parities. Native fixtures use 6..10 square grids with 5..6 row brackets. Larger, non-square and irregular cases are synthetic extensions. Deliberately not supported: other orientations, concave or non-monotone ('{') brackets, multiple objects, non-zero background, and mirrors clipped by the grid border.
authored_constraints: Exactly one 8-connected object of a single colour 1..9 on background 0.
Background is a strict majority (2*strokes < W*H), so the reference's background() picks 0.
Every row of the bracket bbox contains a stroke cell. Offsets start at 0 and are non-decreasing. The leftmost stroke is in the middle row(s).
At least one row is open (some run ends before x1), so the output is never empty.
The mirrored blob fits fully in bounds: x0 + 2*x1 - b_min < W.
Explicit offsets must be a list or tuple of 2..15 ints with offsets[-1]+cap <= 14. Otherwise ValueError is raised before any geometry is built.
Explicit width/height/left/top/cap/even are honoured exactly or rejected. They are never silently weakened.
